roles.name: orchestryx-ecs-execution-role
roles.purpose: ECS task execution role used by Fargate to pull images, write logs, and inject Secrets Manager values.

roles.name: orchestryx-api-task-role
roles.purpose: Runtime role for the FastAPI service. It talks to Cognito and reads/writes platform secrets as currently configured.

roles.name: orchestryx-worker-task-role
roles.purpose: Runtime role for Celery workers. It consumes SQS for asynchronous background tasks. Lab runtime provisioning is disabled.
